plot_events: The narrator states that their master loaded his subjects into the Metabunker with a promise to take them to the Diamond Planet.
The apes are said to have been injected with a heat-immunizing agent and left in a temporary coma.
The comatose apes are expelled into space as drifting organic matter.
A pilot or controller says the craft is no longer responding.
The speaker assumes the organism or vessel will return control after swallowing the organic waste.
The beast ignores neurological commands and begins swallowing the apes.

visual_summary: A narrated space scene shows a vast organic or biomechanical beast engulfing drifting ape bodies around a ship-like structure. Caption boxes explain that the narrator's master had loaded subjects into the Metabunker and promised transport to the Diamond Planet. The apes, rendered comatose by a heat-immunizing injection, are dumped into space as organic matter. In inset panels, a pilot or controller inside the craft says the vessel is no longer responding and expects control to return once it finishes swallowing the waste, but the beast instead follows its primal instinct and consumes the apes.
